documents.name: Puy du Fou
documents.summary: Puy du Fou is a historical spectacle destination in Les Epesses, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Europe’s benchmark destination-scale historical spectacle park, built around technically ambitious live shows rather than rides.

audience.notes: Editorial destination-fit profile derived from the researched positive age span. Bands without positive evidence remain unknown rather than being treated as a positive match or a hard prohibition. Individual rides and activities may have stricter operator rules.

documents.name: Chartres en Lumières
documents.summary: A free, long-season night route transforming Chartres’ cathedral, churches, bridges and civic buildings with light and sound.
documents.whyWorthwhile: One of Europe’s strongest city-scale night environments: the architecture and public realm become a coherent visitor experience across an entire evening.

coreExperience.note: The illuminated route is predominantly visual.

weather.label: Dress for a long outdoor evening
weather.note: Cold or rain can materially shrink the route.

2026-season.note: The announced 2026 programme runs nightly in this window.

coverImage.alt: Chartres Cathedral illuminated with colourful projections during Chartres en Lumières
